Class WeightedDirectedGraph<T>

java.lang.Object
WeightedDirectedGraph<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicGraphInterface<T>, GraphAlgorithmsInterface<T>, GraphInterface<T>
public class WeightedDirectedGraph<T> extends Object implements GraphInterface<T>
An implementation of the graph ADT using a hashed dictionary

      public boolean addEdge(T origin, T end, double edgeWeight)
      Description copied from interface: BasicGraphInterface
      Adds a weighted edge between two given distinct vertices that are currently in this graph. The desired edge must not already be in the graph. In a directed graph, the edge points toward the second vertex given.
      Specified by:
      addEdge in interface BasicGraphInterface<T>
      Parameters:
      origin - An object that labels the origin vertex of the edge.
      end - An object, distinct from origin, that labels the end vertex of the edge.
      edgeWeight - The real value of the edge's weight.
      Returns:
      True if the edge is added, or false if not.
